All 14 admin tabs load their respective headers (Home content, About Us, Approved Partners, Collections, Mutual funds, Fixed deposits, Testimonials, FAQ, Leads, Listings, Partner applications, Market data, Form dropdowns, Database, Site settings).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: admin-badge-listings is driven strictly by status='pending' portfolios. A DRAFT listing currently visible on the 'Listings (approve)' screen with an Approve button won't increment the badge. If the intent is 'items needing admin action', consider including drafts too — otherwise the visible Approve button on drafts is misleading. Not a regression from this iteration.
Minor a11y: DialogContent (Partner T&C modal) still missing aria-describedby (carry-over warning from iter_13).
Nav popover: the account button in Navbar.jsx does not have a data-testid (only Link items inside do). Consider adding data-testid='nav-account-trigger' for test stability.
